summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with recurrent mid-epigastric abdominal pain, nausea, and uncontrolled type 1 diabetes due to intentional insulin omission. She reported feeling more energetic without insulin, but presented with diabetic ketoacidosis, which resolved with subcutaneous insulin therapy. Her pain was consistent with her chronic pancreatitis, and she was maintained on her outpatient Dilaudid regimen. She tolerated oral intake without nausea or vomiting and was discharged home in stable condition after agreeing to resume insulin use. Follow-up with her primary care provider was arranged.
